notes: Controller step-response test (hardware counterpart of sim R223). Same robot settings, payload, gains and S-W-E- start pose (c675) as the clean R187 sysid recording (collection.remapped_full_amplitude_swe_candidate.json). Each step holds a fixed Cartesian target offset in base_link (Thunder: y = world up) for 2 s, then returns to zero for 1.5 s. Max held offset 40 mm / 16 deg, i.e. at most 40 N / 14 N m of spring at Kp 1000 / 50. The joint guard is computed from IK (predicted max excursion + 5 deg). The operator moves the arm to the start pose; the script does not.

policy_test.notes: --mode policy: every 0.1 s the target = measured flange pose + offset (the trained policy's action semantics; sim R223 phases A/C). single = one command then zero action; constant = [size, repeats]. Cumulative command per trial is capped at 40 mm / 16 deg (the held test's envelope), then the target returns to the initial center for 2 s.
